mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, the temperature is 59 degrees with a moderate drizzle near the Verona Area High School, all under the light of a Full Moon.

The Planning Department reminds applicants to watch for email scams asking for online payments; always pay fees by check at the City Administration Building. Additionally, fall leaf collection begins October 5, so please keep leaf piles separate from brush.

Enjoy the Verona Fall Fest today at Hometown USA Festival Park, or catch live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, visit the Dane County Farmers Market or Paddy Mac's for more local entertainment.
On September 10, officers responded to a burglary at Hunters Cove Way where an offender was apprehended after a shot was fired.
Culver's is currently closed for a remodel, but they will be ready to serve you when they open today at 10:00 AM.
